title: Chris Jones: I lied when I said sacks don't matter, sacks are everything

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chris Jones: I lied when I said sacks don't matter, sacks are everything
sources.description: The Chiefs came into Sunday's game against the Jets with nine sacks on the season and that didn't stop them from winning five of their first seven games, but it did lead to a lot of questions about whether the pass rush would come to life.
